LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Represents a player high score entry in the Snake Pro leaderboard per game mode

username.description: The nickname/display name of the player

score.description: The highest score achieved by the player in this mode

mode.description: Game mode: Classic, Missions, or Time

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the score entry was first created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the score entry was last updated

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Leaderboard collection partitioned by mode (Classic, Missions, Time)
